decisions.decision: Map library: MapLibre GL (raw maplibre-gl, no react-map-gl wrapper) over Leaflet
decisions.rationale: GPU-rendered vector tiles fit the milestone's explicit 'genuinely polished' bar better; built-in clustering avoids a second dependency

decisions.decision: Discovery page gated behind the existing shared-secret session (DISC-04)
decisions.rationale: Consistent with the write-path auth boundary; protects the shared RIDB rate budget from anonymous traffic

decisions.decision: Phase order: Tech debt (6) -> RIDB data layer (7) -> Discovery UI (8) -> Map (9) -> Redesign (10)
decisions.rationale: Tech debt first so the new auth-gate route-coverage check protects Phases 7-9's new routes from day one; data layer validates RIDB assumptions before UI depends on them; redesign last so new screens are styled once
Original rate-limit concern was about eager/unbounded querying, not full-catalog search itself; DISC-02 mandates on-demand/paginated availability fetching as the mitigation
